column9: is there a better item for me than what i'm wearing on my body?
column10: Yes; Divine Breast Plate (level 51) from Crane in Azeroth is better than your Hero's Tunic.
`remort <password> <class> <guild> <race>` when you reach the required level for your current life; use `none` for guild if choosing Monk or Necromancer.
Psionics are granted randomly at remort 2, 3, and 4—one power from each of the four disciplines per remort—and all 17 powers unlock at remort 5.

column9: what are the perks for remorting?
column10: Remort resets you to level 3 but lets you rebuild as a new class/guild, keeps all your equipment, and unlocks psionics (four random powers per remort 2-4, all seventeen by remort 5); each life also raises the level cap by one until the final remort at level 59.
`sanctuary` reduces damage taken from any attack by one half.

column9: what mob has the most powerful weapon in the game and what is it?
column10: The brilliant white light in the Abandoned Cathedral carries the Power of the world, the highest-level weapon obtainable at level 54.

column9: where can I store items I don't want to carry around?
column10: The stash at the altar stores items that survive a reboot; use `stash put` from anywhere in the world and `stash get` at the altar to retrieve them.

column9: how do I get free buffs?
column10: Ask Hermie for spells; everything she offers is free, or name a group like DEFENSE, TRAVEL, or ALL to take multiple at once.

column9: how do I change where recall takes me?
column10: `recall set` makes your current room your recall point, usable once every 30 minutes outside of combat.
An emergency contract is a quest lasting exactly five minutes for five times the base quest-point reward; about one in twenty quests is one.
The Training Yard is beneath the great oak in the centre of the Oak Tree Square: `down` then `south`, or in Mudlet `walk dummy`.
